items.title: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds
items.body: The report comes with Wall Street on edge over high-flying AI hyperscalers, while communities are on alert for the rapid spread of data centers.

items.title: Bessent blames Lutnick’s Commerce as he slams Nvidia chip ‘leakage’ to China
items.body: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO days after admitting to an affair following scrutiny of his relationship with a woman reportedly deemed a Chinese spy.

items.title: Wholesale prices rose 0.3% in October, putting annual rate at 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years
items.body: The producer price index was expected to increase 0.4% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

items.title: Analysis: Nvidia’s leadership crisis tests the chipmaker’s role as the ‘central bank of AI’
items.body: The tech giant's web of ties to other companies is raising the possibility that it could do far-reaching economic and financial damage.

items.title: UK economy expands 0.7% in third quarter as AI provides 'extra engine of growth'
items.body: The U.K. economy grew 0.7% in the third quarter of the year, in line with estimates.

items.title: Consumers are showing signs of strain even as they keep spending, CNBC/NRF Retail Monitor shows
items.body: Retail sales rose at their slowest pace in nearly a year in October as American consumers showed signs of strain from high prices.

items.title: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight
items.body: The report comes at a critical juncture for the Federal Reserve as it considers its next move regarding interest rates.

items.title: China's goods surplus tops $1 trillion for a second year amid calls for Beijing to rebalance trade
items.body: China's trade surplus topped $1 trillion as of October, potentially intensifying complaints from trading partners already wary over the glut of cheap Chinese goods.
